incident_bot: 🚨 INCIDENT 3387654321 — High model error-rate observed for tenant 'saffron-pay' in us-west-2 (Dedicated VPC pool). Alert: 7xx inference errors + 500ms p50 increase. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3387654321
ella_oncall: oncall ack, I'm paged. starting preliminary triage. pinging runtime + customer success.
mike_runtime: seeing KV cache thrash on the dedicated pool serving saffron-pay. evictions spike when seq len > 1k, CPU jitter on host-gpu-12. suspect quantized kernel fallback due to memory pressure.
samir_se: FYI Saffron Pay support is on the line, they report downstream failures in production payments flows. They prefer a graceful degraded mode over a full outage.
ekaterina_sre: adding observability notes: traces show 15% of requests falling back to slower path, and repeated model reloads for the pinned variant group.
mike_runtime: proposed live mitigation: pin saffron-pay to the known-safe variant (redwood/gpt-medium-safe:2025-01-17) on the VPC pool, and temporarily disable prefix caching invalidations for that tenant to reduce reload churn. This should cut the 7xxs immediately.
ella_oncall: can we do a quick canary pin to one shard before global? prefer stage to 10% then expand.
mike_runtime: yes. plan: 1) canary pin on shard s-west-2-a (10% traffic) 2) monitor error-rate & latency 3) if stable -> roll to remaining shards. Command: ```
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant saffron-pay --model redwood/gpt-medium-safe:2025-01-17 --shard s-west-2-a --traffic 0.1
```
julie_cs: contacting Saffron Pay ops: they agreed to canary then accelerate to full routing if canary looks good. they explicitly asked we avoid model swap that changes output format. safe variant preserves schema. :thumbsup:
redwood_deploy_bot: deploy job queued: job_id=deploy-3387654321-pin-canary user=mike_runtime
ekaterina_sre: FYI I'll open a short-lived remediation bookmark in console and pin alert thresholds. setting paging to quiet for non-critical noise during the operation.
mike_runtime: canary results after 90s: errors down 78% on shard, p50 latency back to baseline. no schema diffs observed. ready to expand to 100%.
ella_oncall: proceeding to full pin now. command: ```
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant saffron-pay --model redwood/gpt-medium-safe:2025-01-17 --traffic 1.0
```
redwood_deploy_bot: deploy job completed: job_id=deploy-3387654321-pin-full status=success
mike_runtime: full roll complete. monitoring shows sustained error-rate reduction and latency stabilized. KV eviction rate dropped ~60%.
samir_se: relaying to customer: Saffron Pay confirms production flows recovered. They asked for a short postmortem and a request to add safe variant as preferred fallback for their tenant in their contract.
ejekaterina_sre: scheduling post-incident review. immediate actions: (1) increase KV cache headroom on saffron dedicated pool, (2) add safe-variant pin toggle in tenant settings for enterprise customers, (3) simulate large-seq workloads in staging to reproduce eviction pattern.
ella_oncall: closing incident thread for paging. follow-up tasks assigned in the incident board. Thanks all. :heart:
incident_bot: Incident 3387654321 resolved after 56m. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pg/issues/3387654321
